description: Describes the current screen: its fields with their values, its buttons (destructive ones flagged), and its lists with their rows.
name: describe_screen

description: Lists the id and title of every screen the app can open, whichever screen is current.
name: list_screens

description: Opens the screen with the given id, which becomes the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.
name: open_screen

description: Presses the button with the given id on the current screen, after the user's approval if it is destructive, and returns the outcome and the current screen.
name: press_button

description: Selects the row with the given key in the list with the given id on the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.
name: select_row

description: Sets the field with the given id on the current screen to the given value, and returns the outcome and the current screen.
name: set_field
